visual.description: A white modal dialog centered over the page with a newsletter signup form containing a headline, email input, checkbox, and full-width submit button, with an X close button in the top-right corner.
Full-viewport background of oversized all-caps red brand name text on a gray background with the modal overlaid on top.
Fixed navigation bar split into left links (PRODUCTS, ABOUT, RECIPES), centered logo (MATHESON FOOD COMPANY), and right links (FIND US, CONTACT, Instagram icon).

Three equal-width columns displaying product images with text labels below, with a bold section category label (e.g. SEASONING, MACARONI & CHEESE) spanning the full left edge of the viewport as a colored block.
Full-width solid color block (red, green, yellow) with large bold black category name text anchored to the left side, acting as a visual section divider.
Three equal-width product tiles each containing a product photo and all-caps product name label below, arranged in a horizontal row.
Left column contains a large portrait photo; right column contains descriptive body text and a pull quote, with large red background behind the right content area.
Two equal-width columns of recipe cards each containing a thumbnail video/image with an all-caps recipe title overlaid or positioned below.
Full-width horizontal scrolling ticker bar at the bottom repeating the phrase COOK LIKE A MATHESON in all-caps.
Right side features a large bold heading WHERE TO FIND US with a DISCOVER button below it, adjacent to product imagery on the left.
